description: This file provides the implementation of the GitHub Copilot Embedding API configuration, including methods for environment validation, URL construction, request transformation, response processing, and parameter mapping. It defines the class GithubCopilotEmbeddingConfig which customizes behavior specific to GitHub Copilot's embedding service.

classes.name: GithubCopilotEmbeddingConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for GitHub Copilot's Embedding API, extending BaseEmbeddingConfig with methods for environment validation, URL generation, request and response transformation, and parameter handling.
